short_sword.name: Short Sword
short_sword.desc: Your starting blade. Quick, but short.

long_sword.name: Wayfarer's Sword
long_sword.desc: Reaches further and hits harder than the short sword.

dwarvish_broad_sword.name: Dwarvish Broad Sword
dwarvish_broad_sword.desc: Dwarven storm-iron, as long as you are tall. Two-handed: no shield, and slow, but it sweeps a huge arc.

dragon_slayer.name: Severance
dragon_slayer.desc: The only blade that can wound the Everbloom. It hums near stillglass flesh.

small_shield.name: Buckler
small_shield.desc: Hold Block to guard (halves damage). Tap it just before a hit to parry. Wards 20% of foes' sorcery.

battle_suit.name: Elven Plate
battle_suit.desc: The Drowned Warden's harness of bronze and spring-stone: take 60% less damage.

full_plate.name: Knight's Plate
full_plate.desc: Elf-forged plate, light as leaf-silk: take 45% less damage.

large_shield.name: Kite Shield
large_shield.desc: Guarding blocks 70% of a hit, and it wards 30% of foes' sorcery.

magic_shield.name: Warding Shield
magic_shield.desc: Guards 70%, wards 40% of sorcery. A parry flings small shots back, even sap and embers.

battle_helmet.name: Elven Helm
battle_helmet.desc: The elf kings' war-helm, hidden at the Everbloom's threshold: one more mask, 10% less damage, and 20% more of foes' sorcery warded.

jack_key.name: Copper Key
jack_key.desc: Opens one Copper door. Copper doors guard treasure.

queen_key.name: Silver Key
queen_key.desc: Opens one Silver door, the red-lacquered vaults past the Heartwood.

king_key.name: Gold Key
king_key.desc: Opens one Gold door, the iron vaults in the high branches.

ace_key.name: Thorn Key
ace_key.desc: Opens one Thorn door, the elf-silver vaults of the outer world.

life_fruit.name: Life Fruit
life_fruit.desc: Two fruits grow a new mask of health.

ointment.name: Barkbalm
ointment.desc: Rub it on from the pause menu: nothing can hurt you for 10 seconds. You can carry three.

elixir.name: Amber Draught
elixir.desc: If you fall, it revives you where you stand. You can carry one.

temper_1.name: Temper Blade I
temper_1.desc: The smith folds your blade in dwarf fire: +15% damage.

temper_2.name: Temper Blade II
temper_2.desc: A second folding, a Stillglass Shard beaten into the steel: another +15%.

chart_eolis.name: Chart of Hearthroot
chart_eolis.desc: Every street and hall of Hearthroot, inked on your map, even those you have not walked.

chart_trunk.name: Chart of the Heartwood
chart_trunk.desc: The tunnels of the Heartwood outlined on your map. Rooms you have not seen show dimmed.

chart_tower.name: Chart of the Tower
chart_tower.desc: The galleries of the Hollin Tower outlined on your map. Rooms you have not seen show dimmed.

chart_mist.name: Chart of the Haar
chart_mist.desc: The drowned marsh of the Haar outlined on your map, as far as the fog let the skywatchers see. Rooms you have not seen show dimmed.

chart_branches.name: Chart of the High Boughs
chart_branches.desc: The boughs of the High Boughs outlined on your map. Rooms you have not seen show dimmed.

chart_daybreak.name: Chart of the Storm Spires
chart_daybreak.desc: The sky isles of Carillon outlined on your map, as the bell-ringers see them. Rooms you have not seen show dimmed.

chart_dartmoor.name: Chart of Vorrhallow
chart_dartmoor.desc: The drowned capital outlined on your map, sounded hall by hall now the water has gone down. Rooms you have not seen show dimmed.

chart_sunken.name: Chart of the Sunken Spring
chart_sunken.desc: The flooded deeps under Vorrhallow outlined on your map, as far as a sounding line reaches. Rooms you have not seen show dimmed.

fire_scroll.name: Kindle Scroll
fire_scroll.desc: Teaches Kindle: a fireball thrown in an arc that bursts on what it meets and burns away bramble. The Next Spell button switches spells.

tilte_scroll.name: Wisplight Scroll
tilte_scroll.desc: Teaches Wisplight: a spirit orb that wakes, chooses the nearest foe and flies to it. The Next Spell button switches spells.

warden_dye.name: Warden Green
warden_dye.desc: The deep green the Elven wardens wove. The cloak you set out in.

ember_dye.name: Ember Red
ember_dye.desc: Red as the forge-coals of Kettleforge.

tide_dye.name: Tide Blue
tide_dye.desc: The blue of the springs running again.

dusk_dye.name: Dusk Violet
dusk_dye.desc: The color of the Haar at the hour the lanterns are lit.

ash_dye.name: Ash Grey
ash_dye.desc: Bleached pale, like the dwarves' old banners.

saffron_dye.name: Saffron
saffron_dye.desc: Carillon's bell-ringers wear it on festival mornings.

night_dye.name: Night
night_dye.desc: Nearly black, with a violet sheen under the moon.

lord_dye.name: Crown Gold
lord_dye.desc: Woven with light. Only for one who has seen the whole of the Ylden.

slate_dye.name: Grain Slate
slate_dye.desc: The grey of the trial pillars. Earned within the Ring of Walls.

coral_dye.name: Ledge Coral
coral_dye.desc: Bright as a last step taken late. Earned within the Ring of Edges.

thorn_dye.name: Thorn Rose
thorn_dye.desc: A deep rose, struck from every bulb. Earned within the Ring of Thorns.

jade_dye.name: Wind Jade
jade_dye.desc: Light and quick, like the currents. Earned within the Ring of Winds.

frost_dye.name: Still Frost
frost_dye.desc: The pale blue of water held still. Earned within the Ring of Stillness.

plummet_dye.name: Plummet Umber
plummet_dye.desc: The brown of a long fall's last ledge. Earned within the Ring of Falling.
